params.embedder: nomic-embed-text-v1.5-q8 (nomic-embed-text-v1.5.Q8_0.gguf, local llama-server llama-server-linux-x86_64-cpu (b11940)), query prefix "search_query: ", document prefix "search_document: "
params.stack: nugget-store (SQLCipher, temp dir) + nugget-ingest + files connector (native watcher) + nugget-retrieve

metrics.name: ingest.wall_s
metrics.description: Initial ingest: from adding the files source to every file indexed (scan, extract, chunk, embed, store)

metrics.name: ingest.files_per_s
metrics.description: Initial ingest throughput in files

metrics.name: ingest.chunks_per_s
metrics.description: Initial ingest throughput in chunks (each embedded)

metrics.name: ingest.mib_per_s
metrics.description: Initial ingest throughput in file bytes

metrics.name: ingest.chunks
metrics.description: Chunks produced by the initial ingest

metrics.name: ingest.embed.ms_per_1k_chunks
metrics.description: Initial ingest: time spent in embedding calls per 1,000 chunks embedded (sum of call durations; calls may overlap)

metrics.name: ingest.embed.ms_per_1k_items
metrics.description: Initial ingest: time spent in embedding calls per 1,000 items (files)

metrics.name: ingest.embed.share_of_wall
metrics.description: Initial ingest: embedding call time over ingest wall time (capped at 1)

metrics.name: ingest.embed.chars_per_chunk
metrics.description: Mean characters per embedded chunk (task prefix included when the model has one)

metrics.name: resources.db_bytes_per_1k_items
metrics.description: Encrypted database on disk (main file + WAL + SHM) after the initial ingest, per 1k items. Includes fixed overhead (sqlite-vec allocates vectors in blocks of 1024), so small corpora overstate it
